nodes.label: Travelling-salesman tour
nodes.definition: A combinatorial problem that asks for the shortest cycle visiting each city once and returning to the start.

nodes.label: Quantum-inspired genetic algorithm
nodes.definition: A population search that borrows quantum state and gate metaphors to encode and update candidate tours.

nodes.label: Classical genetic algorithm
nodes.definition: A population heuristic using selection, crossover, and mutation to improve candidate tours.

nodes.label: TSPLIB benchmarks
nodes.definition: A standard library of tour instances used to compare algorithms across sizes and structures.

nodes.label: Rotation-angle tuning
nodes.definition: The gate angle that controls how candidates change; the paper identifies it as a key tuning burden.
